text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, good morning, you two! You're both up early. That's the rising stars of Ritto Dorm for you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Mornin'.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Well, I suppose I can hardly blame either of you for being on edge.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The spring Classics season is just about to wrap up. Do make sure to give it your all, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Of course.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …Uh-huh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear it! Now then, everyone around the table. We have a wonderful breakfast waiting for―

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but I need to go train.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Dear me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet starts training for the day.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The sky is clear, and I feel great! Wow, what a wonderful day to train!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go for another lap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help but think she's hiding something…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm… She's still not back to normal, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, excuse me. I hope I didn't startle you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I simply wanted to hear your thoughts on the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Scarlet and Vodka. Surely you're not blind to the tension between them. This morning, it seemed worse than ever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: As their dorm leader and someone with a bit more experience, I want to lend what help I can.
choice_data_list: Thanks for looking out for them.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Not at all. If there's anything I can do to help, just say the word.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: They have the potential to become legendary rivals. To occupy irreplaceable positions in each other's lives.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: To push one another to strive for better. To refine their running that little bit further. But it will take both of them.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume's running reflects the innermost workings of her heart. And it's far too soon to let their light fade.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki watches Daiwa Scarlet train for a little while longer before she leaves.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that Fuji with you just now? Did she need something?
choice_data_list: I hear you're fighting with Vodka again.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What does that matter?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: We've been fighting on and off since we started sharing a room.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's not like today was special or anything. Just business as usual.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right. It's not important. She can do or say whatever she likes, but it's got nothing to do with me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm nothing like her. I'm going to win the Tiara tour and become number one…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph! That's got nothing to do with you either!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Now hurry up and get ready to record my time! I'm planning to break my record today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her grandiosity, Scarlet's form is more rigid than ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume's running reflects the innermost workings of her heart. No truer words have ever been spoken.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Should we continue the Tiara tour with the Japanese Oaks… or should we choose another path?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, it's my responsibility to choose what's best for her. And that is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's best to focus on the path she has chosen for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to prepare for the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she wants to grow, she needs a chance to come to terms with her own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to prepare for the Japanese Derby.
